name: Submission.differentiable_sphere_theorem
statement: ∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M] [IsManifold I ∞ M] [RiemannianBundle (fun (x : M) ↦ TangentSpace I x)] [IsContMDiffRiemannianBundle I ∞ E (fun (x : M) ↦ TangentSpace I x)] [I.Boundaryless] [T2Space M] [CompactSpace M] [SimplyConnectedSpace M], 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E → ∀ (cov : CovariantDerivative I E (TangentSpace I (M := M))) [ContMDiffCovariantDerivative cov ∞], cov.torsion = 0 → IsMetricCompatible cov → LeanEval.Geometry.SphereTheorem.QuarterPinched cov → Nonempty (M ≃ₘ⟮I, 𝓡 (Module.finrank ℝ E)⟯ (sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E + 1))) 1))
